description: Addis harnesses natural geologic processes to produce ammonia at lower cost and with lower emissions. Its approach accelerates subterranean reactions to enable modular, scalable, and decentralized chemical manufacturing.
tagline: Stimulated geologic chemicals production

description: Adiabatic Materials produces pharmaceuticals and industrial chemicals using electricity instead of fossil-based heat. Its platform runs reactions selectively at room temperature, yielding the target product at high purity with far less waste and few byproducts — and bringing supply chains for essential medicines and fine chemicals back onshore.
tagline: Electrified, domestic production of critical chemicals

description: Aepnus is developing an electrochemical platform to produce lithium salts and other industrial chemicals cost-competitively through electrified processes. The technology replaces fossil-driven production with modular, scalable routes designed for batteries and heavy industry.
tagline: Efficient chemicals production, starting with battery supply chains

description: Allie integrates data across machines, sensors, and factory systems to make operations observable and controllable. Its AI-powered analytics and agents detect anomalies, automate workflows, and optimize throughput, efficiency, and cost.
tagline: Factory intelligence and AI automation for manufacturing

description: Alta uses engineered proteins to extract rare earth elements and other critical minerals from e-waste, tailings, and ores. Its biologically mediated separation systems operate under mild conditions and can refine materials below the cost of conventional processes, reshaping where and how critical minerals are sourced.
tagline: Bioengineering for modular, domestic production of critical materials

description: Andes helps farmers improve their farms’ efficiency and improve soil quality. By engineering microbes that fix carbon in soils, Andes lowers input costs and emissions while turning cropland into a durable carbon sink.
tagline: Microbes to boost farm efficiency and sequester carbon in soils

description: ANNEA helps renewable operators get more electricity out of existing assets. Starting with wind, its software anticipates predictable failures and applies automated control and maintenance actions to reduce downtime and increase energy output.
tagline: Predictive maintenance and optimization AI for energy assets

description: Anthro develops batteries that expand the frontiers of whats possible in energy storage. Anthro’s batteries can be flexible, fire-resistant, and ultra energy-dense. Its technology enables batteries to be integrated into new form factors and environments without sacrificing safety, cost, or performance.
tagline: Ultra-dense and safe batteries to enable ubiquitous energy storage

description: Arbor produces clean baseload electricity with cost-competitive, modular gas turbines systems. Arbor’s systems can deploy faster and cheaper than any other baseload power solution, bringing a new era of scalable clean firm power to data centers, industrial customers and the grid.
tagline: Power-dense, modular gas turbines for zero-emissions baseload power

description: Astro Mechanica builds adaptive turboelectric propulsion systems that enable efficient, low-emissions supersonic flight. Paired with sustainable fuels, its technology reimagines aerospace propulsion for speed and sustainability.
tagline: A new standard for speed in supersonic flight

description: Atlas produces high-purity nickel for battery applications through an integrated refining process that also yields low-carbon silica and high purity magnesium, which can be converted to magnesium metal. By co-producing multiple critical materials in a single system, Atlas aligns battery supply with lower cost, lower emissions, and industrial scale.
tagline: Efficient production of nickel, magnesium, cobalt and silica

description: Cache Energy stores excess renewable electricity as heat using a reversible solid-state chemical reaction. The result is low-cost, long-duration thermal storage that can deliver on-demand heat for homes and industrial processes without complex infrastructure.
tagline: Long-duration thermal energy storage enabled by simple chemistry

description: CarbonChain provides real-time emissions accounting across commodities and manufacturing supply chains. Its platform gives enterprises asset-level and cargo-specific carbon data, meeting rising demands from regulators, customers, and markets for transparent decarbonization.
tagline: Carbon traceability software for industrial supply chains

description: Conifer builds axial flux motors using ferrite magnets and a proprietary winding technique. The result: higher power density, lower cost, and scalable motor performance across mobility, robotics, and industrial automation – without dependence on rare earths.
tagline: High-performing and inexpensive electric motors

description: Copper integrates batteries directly into appliances, offering load-shifting, backup power, and simplified electrification. Its product reduces the infrastructure required for home electrification while strengthening the grid edge.
tagline: Energy storage equipped appliances

description: ElectricFish builds modular storage and charging systems that can be deployed without major grid upgrades. This technology enables the rapid deployment of EV charging in underserved areas, with integrated software to balance load and deliver uptime.
tagline: Portable energy storage for ultra-fast EV charging

description: Electroflow converts lithium-rich brines into LFP cathode material in three steps, bypassing lithium carbonate and foreign processing. Its electrochemical process unlocks stranded lithium sources and delivers battery-grade material at lower cost and higher efficiency.
tagline: The direct path from domestic lithium to domestic batteries

description: ENAPI connects the financial, technical, and operational layers of public EV charging. Its software coordinates data flows across market participants, enabling reliable interoperability and a frictionless charging experience for drivers.
tagline: Data infrastructure for a connected EV ecosystem
funding_notes: Verified enapi.com domain via press (Berlin EV charging clearing-house / OCPI connectivity; founders Jakob Kleihues, Dennis Laumen). €2.5M pre-seed early 2024 with Project A, Seedcamp, Helloworld VC; €7.5M seed announced 2025-01-23 led by Voyager Ventures with those existing investors; total €10M per Tech.eu/EU-Startups. Electrive also covers the seed.

description: Endurance produces clean baseload electricity from subsea geothermal resources, integrating drilling, generation, and power offtake into a single deployable seafloor unit. Its systems unlock a previously untapped source of firm, zero-emissions power at gigawatt scale, sized for data centers, industrial customers, and the grid.
tagline: Subsea geothermal systems for zero-emissions baseload power

description: Ento uses software to optimize energy performance in commercial buildings by analyzing existing sensor and equipment data. The platform detects inefficiencies, recommends operational changes, and supports large-scale decarbonization through smarter load management and reduced waste.
tagline: AI to eliminate energy waste in buildings

description: Foundation Alloy produces engineering alloys through MetalsFIRST, a solid-state manufacturing platform that builds high-performance metals without melting. The process unlocks compositions and properties legacy methods can't reach, with fewer processing steps and significantly higher strength than commercial alternatives.
tagline: Solid-state manufacturing of advanced engineering alloys

description: Generate’s tools help architects and developers rapidly evaluate viable mass timber designs using real material inventories and engineering constraints. By shortening early design cycles and simplifying manufacturing alignment, Generate accelerates the development of high-performance prefabricated building systems.
tagline: Accelerating mass timber construction

description: InRange creates localized energy marketplaces that connect landowners, developers, and electricity buyers. Its end-to-end platform handles development, interconnection, and sales, unlocking distributed generation where grid capacity is limited.
tagline: The marketplace for reliable local electricity

description: Intensivate’s parallel processor chip architecture improves power efficiency and throughput for data-intensive workloads. Designed to integrate seamlessly into data centers, its chip addresses rising compute demand while cutting operating costs and energy consumption at scale.
tagline: Ultra-efficient computing chips

description: Leeta’s microwave-based furnace system enables the production of alloys at higher quallity than otherwise possible, and with lower energy use. By integrating automation and analytics, Leeta ensures consistent output quality and cost efficiency for materials used in semiconductors, electronics, and advanced alloys.
tagline: Precision manufacturing for advanced materials

description: Limelight uses light to reduce iron ore, eliminating the need for carbon-based reductants and avoiding associated emissions. Its process enables cost-competitive, lower-carbon steelmaking using abundant low-grade ores, with lower capital requirements than traditional furnaces.
tagline: Lasers to modernize steel production

description: Lydian converts CO₂ and water into fuels and chemical feedstocks through a thermochemical process designed for carbon-neutral production. The system supports drop-in replacements across aviation and industrial chemistry without reliance on biomass or fossil hydrocarbons.
tagline: Carbon-neutral fuels and chemicals

description: Mitti combines remote sensing, IoT, and ground validation to measure and reduce methane emissions from rice farming. These tools help growers implement more efficient practices, verify reductions, and access new revenue from carbon markets – aligning emissions goals with farm profitability.
tagline: Methane reduction throughout agricultural supply chains

description: Moment Energy creates energy storage systems from repurposed EV batteries. By combining refurbished packs with proprietary battery management software, Moment extends system life and delivers lower-cost storage for commercial and utility-scale customers while advancing a more circular battery supply chain.
tagline: Batteries and intelligent management systems for energy storage

description: NewOrbit builds satellites engineered to operate in Very Low Earth Orbit, the band 200 to 300 km above Earth that has remained beyond commercial reach. By flying three times closer to Earth than conventional satellites, its spacecraft deliver higher-resolution imagery, faster data, direct-to-device connectivity, and live HD video at a fraction of the cost of existing systems.
tagline: Satellites engineered for Very Low Earth Orbit

description: Photora develops laser-based metallization tools and consumables that replace silver in solar cells with base metals. This reduces raw material cost, simplifies supply chains, and supports expansion of PV production with fewer constraints on critical materials.
tagline: Revolutionary solar cell metallization

description: Powerline is the control layer for an increasingly complex grid. It ingests telemetry from storage, generation, and transmission assets, applies predictive models, and sends intelligent signals to optimize performance. This is cleaner, smarter power without downtime.
tagline: AI to optimize batteries and electricity systems

description: Remora captures CO₂ directly from emitting machines like trains and trucks and monetizes it through commodity markets. This allows fleets to decarbonize without overhauling vehicles or waiting for new drivetrain technology, while turning pollution into profit.
tagline: Capturing carbon as an industrial commodity

description: SirenOpt uses cold plasma sensors and ML to detect nanometer-scale defects in battery and semiconductor production. Its platform improves yields, lowers scrap rates, and shortens time to revenue in high-value manufacturing lines.
tagline: Real-time intelligence for advanced manufacturing lines

description: Skyven provides electrified heat-as-a-service for industrial facilities, replacing fossil boilers with high-efficiency heat pumps. Its platform combines system design, financing, and controls, enabling rapid deployment of zero-emissions steam.
tagline: High-efficiency heat pumps for industrial heat decarbonization

description: SnowFox uses physical modeling and sensor data to simulate and optimize thermal flows in refrigerated warehouses and cold chain facilities. This reduces energy consumption and improves layout and equipment decisions in a sector historically overlooked in decarbonization efforts.
tagline: Digital twin for cold chain facilities

description: Spore.Bio uses multimodal photonics hardware and a transformer-based AI model to replace legacy technology for bacterial detection. The hardware reads the unique spectral fingerprint of microorganisms driving rapid detection, identification, and quantification for food and beverage, pharmaceutical, cosmetic, and clinical applications.
tagline: Rapid and accurate bacterial diagnostics

description: Technologies to improve fertilizer efficiency and reduce emissions from conventional crop inputs. More to come.
tagline: Optimized plant nutrition and fertilizer application

description: tem redesigns how power is priced and contracted, replacing opaque legacy intermediaries with AI that delivers clearer pricing and structurally lower costs. By aligning energy prices more closely with the underlying cost of generation, tem helps businesses pay less and generators earn more.
tagline: AI-native wholesale energy market
